craft_notes: Sthāyin: the effort exculpated. Sanskrit-first: tāsu anyaiḥ prāktanaiḥ kept the prior-expositors; udyamaḥ me kept my-attempt; gūḍhārtha-prakāśaka kept the disclosed-hidden. Rows: 1 ('revealing its hidden meaning' closes — prakāśaka end-weight). Close: 'revealing its hidden meaning.' Rejected: 'despite many' — kept although (yadyapi concessive); 'obscure' for gūḍha — kept hidden (it is there, veiled).

lines: Earlier ones made many expositions among them —
yet this attempt too is reasonable,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāsvanyaiḥ prāktanairvyākhyāḥ kṛtā yadyapi bhūyasā nyāyyastathāpyudyamo me tadgūḍhārthaprakāśakaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Why write another exposition? → The udyama is justified by gūḍhārtha-prakāśana: prior vyākhyās are many, this one discloses the hidden sense (bhāṣya not prakaraṇa).
c1_essence: Many earlier expositions; this attempt reasonable — revealing the hidden meaning.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of the treasury opened (wonder at the work's own store)
